published_independent_potential_anchor.method: independent geodetic determination, NOT the clock-inferred 3918.1(2.6) m^2/s^2
published_independent_potential_anchor.actual_clocks: 87Sr; not the proposed 171Yb+ E2/E3 thermal experiment
published_independent_potential_anchor.scope: Use only the measured potential magnitude as an external redshift scale. Define positive sign by comparing the higher-lapse site to the lower. Do not transplant source clock performance or treat its measurements as our four-setting data.

independent_calibration_required: local radiation spectrum/thermometry, emissivity, gradients and view factors at every plateau; not inferred from the clock shift under test
potential difference and covariance from independent leveling/gravimetry/geodesy at ion positions; not derived from these clock ratios
declare gravitational-potential sign, rotation and velocity convention; do not count centrifugal/kinematic terms twice

runwise reversible correction ledger, height/temperature labels, settling intervals and full correlated uncertainty

protocol.timing_condition: paired plateau centers symmetric with matched weighting; ideal equal spacing cancels linear drift but not quadratic drift
controls: repeat complete blocks to estimate variance; do not call four means independent raw data

thermal_equilibrium_boundary: Local setpoints may be independently imposed with thermostats. Do not simultaneously assume one global passive equilibrium bath: that instead obeys T_local*N=constant in a static spacetime.
nuisance_boundary: Unknown height-correlated common reference/link bias is exactly degenerate with a common anomalous redshift. Two transitions can test differential response only after differential controls.
